findings.claim: When no surrogate is specified, the collector unconditionally creates contractless string-key members and never inspects MessagePack attributes on the formatted type or its members. Consequently, a referenced type marked [MessagePackObject] with [Key] or [IgnoreMember] is serialized using a name-keyed map containing every public read-write member, rather than the declared integer keys and membership, violating the acceptance criterion that MessagePack attributes be honoured.

receipt_plan.detail: Run GeneratedFormatterReferencedAttributesTests.MessagePackObjectKeysOnReferencedTypeAreHonored. It compiles a referenced assembly containing [MessagePackObject] AttributedType with [Key(0)] Value, generates an annotated formatter in a consuming compilation, and requires the formatter to use WriteArrayHeader rather than WriteMapHeader. On head it fails because the generated formatter is contractless and string-keyed.
